text: Leadership knows what happened. This video makes the dollar case: why the fix we shipped was worth it, measured against numbers Fairmont already signed off on.

This platform targets 99.9% uptime across the six-week harvest window -- roughly sixty minutes of total allowed downtime for the entire season. This incident used about forty of those sixty, in one afternoon.
The fix -- one label, one chart, a CI check, a synthetic health check -- cost a few hours of already-spent time, and runs for next to nothing against an eighteen-thousand-dollar monthly budget.
The alternative was a settlement run against incomplete data, or a disputed grade on a truck already gone -- a season's reliability allowance spent before harvest was half over.
Up next: the formal after-action report this incident earned.
